'''Laren Omas''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]].

==Biography==
Laren Omas supported and oversaw several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] weapons research projects. Omas oversaw the creation of the super [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' and the [[Shadow Arsenal]]. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] had previously worked with many of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] Omas asked to join the team, who were initially skeptical to the purpose of the group. The Colonel wanted to develop a weapon to beat back the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] threat.

Omas [[Death/Legends|died]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The ''Star of Coruscant'' was deorbited and fell to the surface of the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], becoming a target for looters. The science team behind the Shadow Arsenal went their respective ways, apart from [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], the team leader. Godera worked in secret to complete the Arsenal on [[Quesh]].
